risk_summary: The excerpt contains substantial standard forward-looking-risk and accounting-policy boilerplate, with complex terminology and reliance on management estimates. Credit-relevant risks include receivable collectability, inventory obsolescence, contract-cost estimates, and COVID-19 uncertainty, although quantified allowances, revenue mix, and liquidity sources provide meaningful specificity. Management expresses confidence in funding operations over the next twelve months, but the disclosure is partly incomplete due to truncation.
